# Adobe Express

> Adobe Express is a web-based multimedia authoring platform for creating social graphics, stories, and videos with intuitive content creation tools.

Adobe Express (formerly Adobe Spark) provides accessible design and video creation capabilities for students, educators, and content creators. The platform combines visual design tools with multimedia authoring to enable quick production of social media content, web pages, and video stories.
